bear_assumptions: USD 5.6 billion of normalized forward revenue at 3x enterprise value plus USD 5.075 billion net cash, divided by 775 million diluted shares, as weak per-hour monetization, Q3 bookings contraction, AI and safety spending, cash burn and dilution persist.
base_assumptions: USD 6.4 billion of normalized forward revenue at 4x enterprise value plus USD 5.075 billion net cash, divided by 775 million diluted shares, as bookings stabilize after Q3 and margins and free cash flow recover gradually while dilution remains material.
bull_assumptions: USD 7.2 billion of normalized forward revenue at 5x enterprise value plus USD 5.075 billion net cash, divided by 775 million diluted shares, as discovery, older users, advertising and subscriptions restore growth and operating leverage without safety failures or excessive dilution.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh mark clears confidence-adjusted expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, and margin-of-safety gates while bookings, payer growth, per-hour monetization and free cash flow stabilize without rising safety, regulatory or dilution risk; downgrade if engagement weakens, Q3 bookings or cash flow miss guidance, creator and infrastructure costs absorb monetization, safety or regulation impairs trust, or dilution offsets per-share cash generation.
